descriptions.d27h_inventory_setup_800a57b0: Inventory setup: reads the Inventory.Worm, Team and Alliance default tags; clears +220 on each of 16 worms and propagates the tag to their inventories; for 4 teams sets used, name, index and the local flag when bit 25 of the services flags is set, spawns the team's worms through 0x800a5a94 and propagates the team tag; propagates the alliance tag to 4 alliance inventories.
